title: Crisis-outline pulse trough (band+4.20·scale) is narrower than the new casing (band+4.5·scale), so the dark rim peeks outside the pulsing red warning outline
detail: The changed CASING_OVERHANG comment lists only the congestion (+5·scale) and selection (+6·scale) halos as clearing it. At pulse phases 0/15 (factor 0.04/0.05 → 4.20/4.25·scale), the crisis outline drawn on top is narrower than the casing, leaving a dark rim outside the red crisis stroke 2 of every 16 ticks.
recommended_fix: Floor the crisis-outline pulse factor (e.g. max(factor, 0.15)) or raise its base from 4.0 to 4.5·scale so the outline always covers the casing rim.

title: Triangle packet glint is not fully inside the body triangle — its upper-left arc draws on the dark outline triangle, contradicting the 'inside the body' comment
detail: The 0.78× body triangle's left edge at y=−0.34r is x=−0.254r (apex (0,−0.78r), corner (−0.6755r,+0.39r)); the glint circle (center (−0.16r,−0.34r), radius 0.20r) reaches x=−0.36r, so ~0.11r of its arc lands on the dark outline triangle. It stays within the outer outline triangle (edge −0.381r), so no spill outside the packet.
recommended_fix: Move the glint toward the centroid and shrink it (e.g. center (−0.10r, −0.28r), radius 0.16r), or test/clamp it to the body triangle.
